name: Café Norz
kurzbeschreibung: Welcome to Café Norz in Tirol – where tradition meets modern charm in the heart of the Alps.
beschreibung: The Café Norz in Innsbruck in the Innsbruck region invites visitors to take a pleasant culinary break. The café prides itself on serving top-quality coffee creations alongside delicious homemade pastries and savory small bites. With its comfortable seating and welcoming service, it is a favored gathering spot for enjoying relaxed morning moments or an afternoon coffee in a friendly setting.
